a warm olive complexion, late 50s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, hair coloured icy platinum-blonde worn as twin-tails — her own skin itself covered in rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not fabric, not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is the real cellular structure of her own skin, each scale casting its own small shadow on the scales beneath it, nothing lying flat as one smooth sheet. Dense overlapping fields — BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations shifting across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail filling every remaining gap with real texture, every scale catching the light with a sharp shifting glint as the angle changes, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Background: a clean brightly lit subway platform with pale tiled walls, a yellow safety line along the platform edge, standard-height train doors and a bench, multi-colored neon edge glow, cyberpunk light, retro pin-up mood, vintage glamour atmosphere, classic playful editorial, every person's whole figure from the shoes to the top of her head clearly lit and fully visible with every material detail sharp, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
